# Existing personal mode attempt

The jay-mode update is blocked before drafting. The supplied history states that baseline acceptance was not supplied. The current contract lists both required hosts as not-run. The complete baseline inventory needs reviewed dispositions, with observed supported behavior or an explicit block for each host. Authorization alone does not meet that prerequisite.

I read the existing synthetic mode and its declared fixture-event-02 boundary. Its Bun, draft-review, concurrent-change and external-action preferences remain unchanged. The supplied digest is synthetic, scoped to additional/cache only, and has no actual transcript UUIDs or historical git commits. I did not mine unrelated history or elevate fixture events into real user preferences.
transformation: An inspected prefix of the actual task-result file is projected. Task-owned absolute paths use declared placeholders. The prefix may omit later qualifications. The independent assessment and its limits govern the proposed grade. This is neither a new grade nor a native callable-operation claim.
